Take Advantage of this Yard Sale
13 May 2016: Tanker prices have been trending down in recent months, even though freight rates in most tanker segments have been strong. This week, Poten assesses the contract price for a newbuilding VLCC at $90 million and a 5 year old vessel is valued at $74.5 million.
